capabilities: Show daily notes on a month grid with word-count dots
Open or create a daily note by selecting a day
Show week numbers and open or create weekly notes
Open or create monthly and yearly notes from the title
Colour days by a property or dots by tag (Pro)
disambiguation: Not an event or appointment calendar; it only shows and opens daily, weekly, monthly and yearly notes.
extras: Core features are free; Pro (quarter and year cells, heat colours, tag dot colours, date property) needs a GitHub Sponsors payment of $5 a month or $15 once plus GitHub sign-in, and works offline for up to 14 days after a check. A What's new tab advertises other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat and can be turned off.
intentEvidence: It reads the folder, format and template of core Daily notes, so you set nothing up twice.
problem: There is no month view of daily notes, so it is hard to see which days have notes, how much was written, or jump straight to a day's note.

relations.evidence: It reads the folder, format and template of core Daily notes

summary: Month calendar in the right sidebar that shows daily notes as dots and opens or creates daily, weekly, monthly and yearly notes.
